reason: My first thought is still that Apollo plus a junior SDR would do it cheaper, but a junior costs me more than EUR 900 in one month before he books anything, and here the first 3 meetings are free and I can stop. I'd do the free 15-company list and, if those companies are ones I don't already know from the fairs, run the pilot ahead of our next fair.
objection: That the 15 companies are the obvious names any Apollo search gives me, and that EUR 300 a meeting turns out to be for polite intro calls with people who never send a quote request. After the pilot I'd be tempted to take the playbook and the domains and run it in-house.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 is generic, names I already know or found with a basic filter, I walk away and do it myself with Apollo.
